description: This source file defines the 'Activity' class within the Opencart admin extension for report-related functionalities. It includes a method to fetch recent customer activities from the database.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A class that provides methods related to customer activity reporting within the Opencart admin extension.

methods.name: getActivities
methods.description: Retrieves the latest customer activity records from the database, limited to the five most recent entries.
